description: The Space Mission Design Game is an interactive educational game where students act as space mission engineers. Players design missions by choosing rockets, spacecraft, instruments, and objectives while managing budgets and technical requirements. Through realistic simulations of launches and space operations, they explore mission challenges and outcomes. The game makes space science engaging while developing problem-solving, critical-thinking, and decision-making skills.
summary:
ORBIT ODYSSES – Project Summary
NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026

Orbit Odysseys is an interactive space exploration and mission design platform developed to make space science and spacecraft engineering more engaging and accessible.

The platform allows users to explore the Solar System, and understand the science behind planetary exploration. Its interactive Solar System experience helps users learn about planets and their movements.

Users can also explore spacecraft design by selecting and configuring different spacecraft components while understanding important engineering concepts such as payload mass, structural requirements, power systems, communication systems, and orbital mechanics.

The platform introduces the essential stages of space exploration through spacecraft design, launch sequences, and mission planning. It demonstrates how engineering decisions influence the success of a space mission.

Our goal is to transform complex space science concepts into an interactive learning experience, inspiring students and space enthusiasts to understand, design, and explore beyond Earth.
details:
Project Details – ORBIT ODYSSEYS

NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026

ORBIT ODYSSEYS is an interactive space exploration and spacecraft design platform that combines 3D Solar System visualization with practical spacecraft engineering concepts.

Our project allows users to explore the Solar System through an interactive 3D environment featuring , their rotations and revolutions, orbital paths, and asteroids. Users can observe planetary movements and develop a better understanding of our cosmic neighbourhood.

The platform also includes a spacecraft design and rocket selection experience. Users can explore different launch vehicles and select spacecraft components, scientific instruments, equipment, and payloads. Each component has an individual weight, and the system automatically calculates the total payload mass whenever components are added or removed. It also checks the selected rocket's payload capacity to prevent incompatible configurations.

Benefits and Intended Impact:

- Makes space science more interactive and accessible.

- Helps students understand planetary motion and orbital mechanics.

- Introduces real-world spacecraft engineering concepts.

- Encourages creativity, scientific curiosity, and problem-solving.

- Provides an engaging educational experience for aspiring space enthusiasts.

Technologies Used:

- HTML5 – Website structure.

- CSS3 – Styling, animations, and responsive interface.

- JavaScript – Interactive features, calculations, and simulation.

- Web-based 3D graphics technologies – Solar System and spacecraft visualization.

Creativity and Design Considerations:

Our creativity lies in combining Solar System exploration with spacecraft engineering in one interactive platform. We considered scientific accuracy, realistic payload limitations, usability, visual experience, and educational value while developing the project.

Our Vision: To make space exploration understandable, interactive, and inspiring, encouraging the next generation to think beyond Earth.
